description: Akash deployment kit — the exact SDL, boot-test and lease runbook we used to put a live container on Akash, including the four failure modes that cost us real attempts: deposits must be uact not uakt, the BME minimum mint is 10 ACT, akash 2.1.2 has no provider subcommand, and provider-services takes the node as an env var not a flag. Drop in your image and port, get a working manifest plus a verified proof URI from our own lease.
name: akari_akash_deploy_kit
